blind.description: A low, stylized mound of ruined masonry blocks, angular rocks, and pebbles bedded in tan sand or crushed mortar. Among the carved and chiseled stone blocks is a fragmented piece of a fluted classical column. The surfaces are solid, polygonal, and hand-painted/stylized with highlighted beveled edges. The pile rests directly flat on the ground without an extra base plinth. Colors are earthy warm greys and muted tan/buff.
blind.from_above: A compact roughly square cluster of interlocking grey polygonal stone blocks and a ribbed architectural fragment, separated by lighter sand-colored filler.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/4 the height of the figure (around 1.5 feet / 0.5 m tall), and roughly 4 to 5 feet wide (nearly as wide as the figure is tall).
